name: Button
summary: Triggers an action or submits a form. Not for navigation — use Link so screen readers announce the correct role.

variant.intent: Visual weight. One primary per view. danger for destructive actions, always paired with confirmation for irreversible ones.

size.intent: Target heights 24 / 32 / 44 px. lg is the touch default.

isDisabled.intent: Removes from tab order. Prefer enabled + validation message so users learn why.

isPending.intent: Shows a spinner, keeps width and focus, sets aria-busy, suppresses onPress.

isFullWidth.intent: Stretches to container inline-size; typical in mobile forms.

iconStart.intent: Decorative icon before the label; aria-hidden applied automatically.

iconEnd.intent: Decorative icon after the label; aria-hidden applied automatically.

aria-label.requiredWhen: children is empty (icon-only). Use IconButton instead where possible.
aria-label.intent: The accessible name when there is no visible text.

onPress.intent: Unified activation for mouse, touch, keyboard (Enter/Space) and assistive tech.

type.intent: Native form behaviour; submit only inside a Form.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to / from the button.
Activates on key up (native behaviour preserved).

a11y.name: Computed from children; from aria-label when icon-only (TypeScript union requires it).
a11y.announcements: isPending: aria-busy=true and a visually-hidden 'Loading' appended to the name; label text stays visible.

rules: Never use Button for navigation; use Link.
Never disable the submit button to signal an invalid form; validate and explain.
Focus ring uses outline + outline-offset, never box-shadow alone (box-shadow is clipped by overflow and ignored in forced-colors mode).
In forced-colors mode (Windows High Contrast) keep a visible border: use border-color: ButtonText via @media (forced-colors: active).
